# Logo files

<!-- generated by tools/build.py from LOGO_GROUPS; do not edit by hand -->

Download what you need directly from this folder. Rules for using them are in
[../logo.md](../logo.md).

<img src="svg/binder-logo.svg" width="360" alt="BINDER logo">

## Which file to take

| You are doing | Take |
|---|---|
| Website, app, anything on screen | **SVG** — scales to any size |
| Office document, quick placement | **PNG** — transparent background |
| Print, layout, handing to a printer | **PDF** or **EPS** |

SVGs are cropped to the artwork. Clear space is applied in layout, not baked
into the file.

## The three rules people get wrong

1. **The word mark never appears without the symbol** (the red triangles).
2. **Below 30 mm width, use a version without the claim** — it stops being legible.
3. **Clear space is 1.5 × the height of the symbol** on all sides.

Everything else: [../logo.md](../logo.md).
